entry.summary: RT Eric Wallzard If you want to understand what happens to funds after they’re stolen by North Korea/Lazarus Group, the Chainalysis 2022 report is great Step 1: Swap any ERC20s (like stETH) into ETH Step 2: Swap any ETH into BTC Step 3: Cash out BTC to cash (Chinese Renminbi) using Asian exchanges This process can take years. They are in no hurry. In 2022, it was noted how North Korea was still sitting on $55 worth of funds from hacks that happened six years earlier (2016).
